newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 290,500 metric tons (MT) were one-half above the previous week and one-fifth above the 4-week average.
The primary buyers were Taiwan (68,000 MT), Israel (40,000 MT, including 36,100 MT switched from 1997/98), Yemen (40,000 MT), the Philippines (34,700 MT), and Venezuela (28,200 MT).

Net sales for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year totaling 17,400 MT included increases for Mexico (20,500 MT), unknown destinations (20,000 MT), and Italy (10,000 MT) and decreases for Israel (36,100 MT).

Exports of 295,600 MT were down 26 percent from the week earlier and 38 percent from the 4-week average. The principal recipients were the Philippines (72,200 MT), Nigeria (30,100 MT), Peru (26,200 MT), South Korea (26,000 MT), and Venezuela (25,200 MT).
